mark.10.p1.b1.text: Then Jesus left that place and went into the region of Judea, beyond the Jordan.

mark.10.p1.b2.text: Again the crowds came to Him and He taught them, as was His custom.

mark.10.p1.b3.text: Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife?

mark.10.p1.b4.text: Some Pharisees came to test Him.

mark.10.p2.b2.text: Moses permitted a man to write his wife a certificate of divorce and send her away.

mark.10.p2.b3.text: Moses wrote this commandment for you because of your hardness of heart.

mark.10.p3.b1.text: However, from the beginning of creation, ‘God made them male and female.’

mark.10.p3.b2.text: For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife,

mark.10.p3.b3.text: And the two will become one flesh.

mark.10.p3.b4.text: Therefore what God has joined together, let man not separate.

mark.10.p4.b1.text: When they were back inside the house, the disciples asked Jesus about this matter.

mark.10.p4.b2.text: Whoever divorces his wife and marries another woman commits adultery against her.

mark.10.p4.b3.text: And if a woman divorces her husband and marries another man, she commits adultery.

mark.10.p5.b1.text: Now people were bringing the little children to Jesus for Him to place His hands on them,

mark.10.p5.b2.text: And the disciples rebuked those who brought them.

mark.10.p5.b3.text: Let the little children come to Me, and do not hinder them!

mark.10.p5.b4.text: For the kingdom of God belongs to such as these.

mark.10.p6.b1.text: Truly I tell you, anyone who does not receive the kingdom of God like a little child

mark.10.p6.b3.text: And He took the children in His arms, placed His hands on them, and blessed them.

mark.10.p7.b1.text: As Jesus started on His way, a man ran up and knelt before Him.

mark.10.p7.b2.text: Good Teacher, … what must I do to inherit eternal life?

mark.10.p7.b3.text: Why do you call Me good?

mark.10.p7.b4.text: No one is good except God alone.

mark.10.p8.b1.text: You know the commandments: Do not murder, do not commit adultery, do not steal,

mark.10.p8.b2.text: Do not bear false witness, do not cheat others, honor your father and mother.

mark.10.p8.b3.text: Teacher, … all these I have kept from my youth.

mark.10.p9.b1.text: Jesus looked at him, loved him,

mark.10.p9.b2.text: There is one thing you lack: Go, sell everything you own and give to the poor,

mark.10.p9.b3.text: And you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow Me.

mark.10.p9.b4.text: But the man was saddened by these words and went away in sorrow, because he had great wealth.

mark.10.p10.b1.text: How hard it is for the rich to enter the kingdom of God!

mark.10.p10.b2.text: And the disciples were amazed at His words.

mark.10.p10.b3.text: Children, how hard it is to enter the kingdom of God!

mark.10.p10.b4.text: It is easier for a camel to pass through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God.

mark.10.p11.b3.text: With man this is impossible, but not with God.

mark.10.p11.b4.text: For all things are possible with God.

mark.10.p12.b1.text: Look, we have left everything and followed You.

mark.10.p12.b2.text: Truly I tell you, … no one who has left home or brothers or sisters or mother or father or children or fields for My sake and for the gospel

mark.10.p12.b3.text: Will fail to receive a hundredfold in the present age … along with persecutions—and in the age to come, eternal life.

mark.10.p12.b4.text: But many who are first will be last, and the last will be first.

mark.10.p13.b1.text: As they were going up the road to Jerusalem,

mark.10.p13.b2.text: Jesus was walking ahead of them.

mark.10.p13.b4.text: But those who followed were afraid.

mark.10.p14.b1.text: Look, we are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be delivered over to the chief priests and scribes.

mark.10.p14.b2.text: They will condemn Him to death and will deliver Him over to the Gentiles,

mark.10.p14.b3.text: Who will mock Him and spit on Him and flog Him and kill Him.

mark.10.p14.b4.text: And after three days He will rise again.

mark.10.p15.b1.text: Teacher, we want You to do for us whatever we ask.

mark.10.p15.b2.text: What do you want Me to do for you?

mark.10.p15.b4.text: That one of us may sit at Your right hand and the other at Your left

mark.10.p16.b1.text: You do not know what you are asking, … Can you drink the cup I will drink, or be baptized with the baptism I will undergo?

mark.10.p16.b3.text: You will drink the cup that I drink, … and you will be baptized with the baptism that I undergo.

mark.10.p16.b4.text: But to sit at My right or left is not Mine to grant. These seats belong to those for whom they have been prepared.

mark.10.p17.b1.text: When the ten heard about this, they became indignant with James and John.

mark.10.p17.b2.text: You know that those regarded as rulers of the Gentiles lord it over them,

mark.10.p17.b3.text: And their superiors exercise authority over them.

mark.10.p18.b1.text: But it shall not be this way among you.

mark.10.p18.b2.text: Instead, whoever wants to become great among you must be your servant,

mark.10.p18.b3.text: For even the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve,

mark.10.p18.b4.text: And to give His life as a ransom for many.

mark.10.p19.b1.text: Next, they came to Jericho. And as Jesus and His disciples were leaving Jericho with a large crowd,

mark.10.p19.b2.text: A blind beggar named Bartimaeus, the son of Timaeus, was sitting beside the road.

mark.10.p19.b3.text: Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!

mark.10.p20.b1.text: Many people admonished him to be silent,

mark.10.p20.b2.text: Son of David, have mercy on me!

mark.10.p20.b4.text: Take courage! … Get up! He is calling for you.

mark.10.p21.b1.text: Throwing off his cloak, Bartimaeus jumped up and came to Jesus.

mark.10.p21.b2.text: What do you want Me to do for you?

mark.10.p22.b1.text: Go, … your faith has healed you.

mark.10.p22.b2.text: And immediately he received his sight

mark.10.p22.b3.text: And followed Jesus along the road.
